meta.note: Designed from scratch for the SecAI open-source security scanner; source kept in hdbrzgr/SecAI packages/ui.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Holds ink and ink-muted text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, inputs. Holds ink, ink-muted and every sev-* and status text color.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table headers, wells and the track of progress bars. Holds ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for rows, list items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table row dividers, section rules. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 on canvas and surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, timestamps, table headers. On canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The SecAI brand color. Primary buttons, links, active tab, selected state and the focus ring. As text, on canvas, surface and signal-soft.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of signal fills.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows, the active nav item and signal badges.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal or signal-strong fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep brand navy for large brand areas: the cover and marketing bands. Holds on-night text.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on a night fill.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Passed checks, verified domains, fixed findings. An alias of signal: always paired with a check icon or the word, never color alone.

tokens.name: pass-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind pass text (verified badge, success alert).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failures (failed scan, failed verification). As text, on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text (error alert, failed badge).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the danger button label).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings that need attention but are not failures (expiring verification, partial scan). As text, on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: sev-critical
tokens.usage: Critical findings: exploitable now, fix first. Label text, severity pips and bar segments. As text, on surface and sev-critical-soft. Always shown with the severity word.

tokens.name: sev-critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the critical severity badge and of highlighted critical rows.

tokens.name: sev-high
tokens.usage: High findings. Label text, severity pips and bar segments. As text, on surface and sev-high-soft. Always shown with the severity word.

tokens.name: sev-high-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the high severity badge and of highlighted high rows.

tokens.name: sev-medium
tokens.usage: Medium findings. Label text, severity pips and bar segments. As text, on surface and sev-medium-soft. Always shown with the severity word.

tokens.name: sev-medium-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the medium severity badge and of highlighted medium rows.

tokens.name: sev-low
tokens.usage: Low findings. Label text, severity pips and bar segments. As text, on surface and sev-low-soft. Always shown with the severity word.

tokens.name: sev-low-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the low severity badge and of highlighted low rows.

tokens.name: sev-info
tokens.usage: Informational findings, no direct risk. Label text, severity pips and bar segments. As text, on surface and sev-info-soft. Always shown with the severity word.

tokens.name: sev-info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the info severity badge and of highlighted info rows.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. An alias of signal, underlined on hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px from the element. 3:1 or more on canvas, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-add
tokens.usage: Added lines in a fix diff (with a + sign; never color alone).

tokens.name: code-add-soft
tokens.usage: Background of added lines in a fix diff.

tokens.name: code-remove
tokens.usage: Removed lines in a fix diff (with a − sign; never color alone).

tokens.name: code-remove-soft
tokens.usage: Background of removed lines in a fix diff.

tokens.name: code-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of the line a finding points at inside a code block.

families.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero and the cover. One per page at most.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on report and dashboard pages.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The security grade letter and score numerals. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Finding titles, dialog titles, table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: explanations, fix guidance, form help.
styles.sample: Add the header in your web server config so every response carries it.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, table cells in dense tables.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: table headers, eyebrow labels, severity words in badges. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code blocks, URLs, file paths, headers, DNS records, CWE ids.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Inline code in dense rows: locations in finding rows, line numbers.

styles.name: mono-strong
styles.usage: The value a user must copy exactly (verification token).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pip gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense lists, control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between form fields, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top padding, large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Severity pips, progress bar segments, diff markers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and progress bars only.

shadow.note: Edges come from line borders; shadows are reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas (with a line border).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, menus, toasts.

size.note: Control heights. Every control in one row shares a height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs inside dense tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call to action on auth and marketing pages; touch targets.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the app content column.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of explanation and fix-guidance text.
